newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London steady around HK close.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London steady around HK close.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were mostly unchanged in very thin trade on Thursday as investors took a breather after recent volatility and sharp overnight gains in Hong Kong.
"It has been an extremely quiet day, even the turnover in HongKong (& Shanghai) Bank was very thin," said one trader.
The Hang Seng Index surged 135.5 points or 0.92 percent to 14,839.23 on Thursday. In London the Reference Index was up just 12 points to 14,851.26 by 1425 GMT.

"People don't seem to think the market will do very much for the rest of the week," the trader said. "After the huge volatility in the market surrounding the handover things have quietened down considerably."
Shares in HSBC Holdings were trading at HK$241.75 in London, up slightly from a close of HK$241.
